schema_sql.attachments: CREATE TABLE attachments ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, file_path TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , size INTEGER)
schema_sql.dynamic_metrics: CREATE VIEW dynamic_metrics AS SELECT k.key AS key, p.value AS value, p.step AS step, p.logged_at AS logged_at FROM metric_points p JOIN metric_keys k ON k.id = p.metric_id
schema_sql.dynamic_metrics_no_legacy_insert: CREATE TRIGGER dynamic_metrics_no_legacy_insert INSTEAD OF INSERT ON dynamic_metrics BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'this experiment uses schema revision 3; upgrade luml-sdk to write to it'); END
schema_sql.eval_annotations: CREATE TABLE eval_annotations ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL, eval_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(annotation_kind IN ('feedback', 'expectation')), value_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_type IN ('int', 'bool', 'string')), value TEXT NOT NULL, user TEXT NOT NULL, rationale TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id, eval_id) REFERENCES evals(dataset_id, id) )
schema_sql.eval_traces_bridge: CREATE TABLE eval_traces_bridge ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, eval_dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL, eval_id TEXT NOT NULL, trace_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
schema_sql.evals: CREATE TABLE evals ( id TEXT NOT NULL, dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL, inputs TEXT NOT NULL, outputs TEXT, refs TEXT, scores TEXT, metadata TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, id) )
schema_sql.exp_schema_info: CREATE TABLE exp_schema_info ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL ) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.exp_schema_migrations: CREATE TABLE exp_schema_migrations ( version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
schema_sql.metric_buckets: CREATE TABLE metric_buckets ( level INTEGER NOT NULL, metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, bucket INTEGER NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, finite_count INTEGER NOT NULL, min REAL, max REAL, sum REAL, first_step INTEGER NOT NULL, last_step INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (level, metric_id, bucket) ) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.metric_keys: CREATE TABLE metric_keys ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE )
schema_sql.metric_points: CREATE TABLE metric_points ( metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, step INTEGER NOT NULL, value REAL, logged_ms INTEGER, logged_at TIMESTAMP GENERATED ALWAYS AS (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', logged_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch')) VIRTUAL, PRIMARY KEY (metric_id, step) ) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.span_annotations: CREATE TABLE span_annotations ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, trace_id TEXT NOT NULL, span_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(annotation_kind IN ('feedback', 'expectation')), value_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_type IN ('int', 'bool', 'string')), value TEXT NOT NULL, user TEXT NOT NULL, rationale TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (trace_id, span_id) REFERENCES spans(trace_id, span_id) )
schema_sql.spans: CREATE TABLE spans ( trace_id TEXT NOT NULL, span_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_span_id TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind INTEGER, dfs_span_type INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, start_time_unix_nano BIGINT NOT NULL, end_time_unix_nano BIGINT NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER, status_message TEXT, attributes TEXT, events TEXT, links TEXT, trace_flags INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (trace_id, span_id) )
schema_sql.static_params: CREATE TABLE static_params ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT, value_type TEXT )
